requirements_text:
Emphasis in Chinese Language and Literature
12 courses (48 units) are required for the Chinese Language and Literature Emphasis.
A. Complete:
CHINESE 103C | Advanced Mandarin Chinese 1
B. Complete:
CHINESE 100A - 100B | Classical Chinese and Classical Chinese
C. Select one of the following:
EAS 15C | Introductory Topics in Chinese Literature
EAS 15J | Introductory Topics in Japanese Literature
EAS 15K | Introductory Topics in Korean Literature
D. Complete:
EAS 190 | Junior-Senior Colloquium
E. Select one upper-division course from the following:
EAS 130 | Topics in Korean Society and Culture
EAS 140 | Topics in Korean Literature and Society
KOREAN 104A | Fourth-Year Korean
HISTORY 173G | Topics in the History of Korea
EAS 120 | Topics in Japanese Literature and Society
EAS 123 | Structure of Japanese
JAPANSE 104A | Fourth Year Japanese
JAPANSE 104B | Fourth Year Japanese
HISTORY 172G | Topics in the History of Japan
SOC SCI 178E | Japanese American Studies
F. Select six additional courses from the following, of which two may be lower-division courses: 2
ART HIS 151B | Later Imperial China
ART HIS 151C | Modern China
CHINESE 104A | Fourth-Year Mandarin Chinese
CHINESE 105 | Topics in Professional Chinese
CHINESE 115 | Topics in Chinese Literature: Advanced Texts
EAS 110 | Topics in Chinese Literature and Society
INTL ST 176C | Political Power in Contemporary China
INTL ST 158D | China in the Global Age
POL SCI 151B | Political Power in Contemporary China
HISTORY 171D | Chinese History to 1800
HISTORY 171E | Chinese History: 1800-1949
HISTORY 171G | Topics in the History of China
SOCIOL 175B | China in the Global Age
Emphasis in Chinese Culture and Society
13 courses (52 units) are required for the Chinese Culture and Society Emphasis.
CHINESE 2C | Intermediate Mandarin Chinese 1
or equivalent.
HISTORY 171D - 171E | Chinese History to 1800 and Chinese History: 1800-1949
E. Select two upper-division courses from the following:
JAPANSE 103A | Advanced Japanese
JAPANSE 103B | Advanced Japanese
F. Select two upper-division courses in the School of Social Sciences dealing with China.
G. Select five additional courses of which no more than two may be lower-division courses offered by the East Asian Studies Department. Additionally, no more than two courses may be from the School of Social Sciences.
CHINESE 100A | Classical Chinese
CHINESE 100B | Classical Chinese
Departmental Requirements for the Major in Chinese Studies
If a student is exempted from CHINESE 103C based on examination or equivalent, a course on a Chinese topic offered by the Department is required.
Other courses may be applied by petition with approval from the undergraduate faculty director for the East Asian Studies Department.
If a student is exempted from CHINESE 2C , an upper-division course on a Chinese topic offered by the East Asian Studies Department is required.
Other courses may be applied by petition with approval from the undergraduate faculty director of the East Asian Studies Department.
Residence Requirement for the Major: At least five upper-division courses required for the major must be completed successfully at UCI. Students are encouraged, however, to complete up to a year of their language study in approved programs of study abroad.
